dimensions.assessment: Affects visitors to specific federal swimming areas and local government entities that may enter into agreements.
dimensions.evidence: enable lifeguards employed by those local government agencies to adequately staff such designated swim location

dimensions.assessment: Provides local lifeguard coverage at federally managed beaches experiencing staffing shortages.
dimensions.evidence: ensure visitor safety and provide rescue and first aid services at the designated swim location as necessary

dimensions.assessment: Requires federal reimbursement to local government agencies for reasonable costs incurred under agreements.
dimensions.evidence: the local government agency providing the lifeguard services is reimbursed for all reasonable costs incurred

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes specific agreements between the Department of the Interior and local governments for designated swim locations.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary may seek to enter into an agreement with one or more local government agencies

dimensions.assessment: Ongoing operational authority for federal land management agencies.

missing_information: Exact number of swimming locations or staff affected nationwide
importance_detail.rationale: The bill provides a framework for federal agencies to contract with local government agencies to staff swimming areas during lifeguard shortages, affecting specific federal recreation sites.
